caption:
Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The boy is for (the owner of) the bed and the stone is for the person who commits illegal sexual intercourse."

Sahih al-Bukhari 6818. Part 39 of 52 in our series on everything the Quran and the Prophet's hadith say about zina. Swipe for the Arabic, English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

#Hadith #Chastity #IslamicReminder #Deen #Guidance

sourcing.primary_text: Sahih al-Bukhari 6818 (hadith-api numbering; Book 86, Hadith 46). Selected from a full-text scan of all hadith-api English editions (Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, Nasa'i, Ibn Majah, Malik, Nawawi, Dehlawi) for zina / adultery / fornication / illegal sexual intercourse / prostitution; one representative narration per distinct statement of the Prophet.
sourcing.arabic_and_english: Live-fetched twice on 2026-10-17 from cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/fawazahmed0/hadith-api@1/editions/ara-bukhari and eng-bukhari, HTTP 200, the two fetches diffed identical. Slides written programmatically from the API text.
sourcing.arabic_extraction: Arabic slide shows the Prophet's words only (text between the quotation marks, or a marked sub-range where the API Arabic has no quotes); chain of narrators omitted from the slide, not altered. Invisible directional marks and stray quote characters removed.
sourcing.english_note: English trimmed only at the edges where noted (chain/narrator commentary), punctuation restored at the end only. Final slide text: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The boy is for (the owner of) the bed and the stone is for the person who commits illegal sexual intercourse."
sourcing.grade: Collection: Sahih al-Bukhari (no grade supplied by hadith-api)
sourcing.chinese_korean_japanese_malay_thai_spani: hadith-api has no Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai or Spanish edition. These six slides are Claude's own translation from the verified Arabic and English, labelled on-slide as such; no scholar is named.
sourcing.compliance_check: Checked against 142 halal-policy string terms across English and translations: hits = []. The text is the Prophet's teaching on the prohibition and legal treatment of zina; not promotional or explicit.
